svg.aria-label: Who does what in JFrog SaaS. JFrog looks after the platform itself: servers and infrastructure on AWS, Google Cloud or Azure, automatic updates, maintenance, the software, and your site address. You look after what goes in it: repositories, projects and people, what you upload, your rules, and connecting your tools.
